tasks.label: qmake: Configure
args: . ./scripts/env.ps1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build | Out-Null; Set-Location build; qmake ../tmDataQualityAnalyzer.pro -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=debug

tasks.label: Build App (Debug)
args: . ./scripts/env.ps1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build | Out-Null; Set-Location build; qmake ../tmDataQualityAnalyzer.pro -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=debug; nmake -f Makefile.Debug

tasks.label: Build (Debug)
args: . ./scripts/env.ps1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build | Out-Null; Set-Location build; qmake ../tmDataQualityAnalyzer.pro -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=debug; & $env:TMDQ_MAKE -f Makefile.Debug; Set-Location ../tests; qmake tests.pro -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=debug; & $env:TMDQ_MAKE -f Makefile.Debug; Set-Location ..; ./scripts/deploy_qt_local.ps1 -Config debug; ./scripts/deploy_qt_local.ps1 -Config debug -Tests

tasks.label: Build (Release)
args: . ./scripts/env.ps1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build | Out-Null; Set-Location build; qmake ../tmDataQualityAnalyzer.pro -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=release; & $env:TMDQ_MAKE -f Makefile.Release; Set-Location ..; ./scripts/deploy_qt_local.ps1 -Config release

tasks.label: Clean
args: . ./scripts/env.ps1; Set-Location build; if (Test-Path Makefile) { nmake -f Makefile clean }

tasks.label: Force Build (Debug)
args: . ./scripts/env.ps1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path build | Out-Null; Set-Location build; qmake ../tmDataQualityAnalyzer.pro -spec win32-msvc CONFIG+=debug; Set-Location ${workspaceFolder}; Get-ChildItem src,include -Recurse -Include *.cpp,*.h | ForEach-Object { $_.LastWriteTime = Get-Date }; Set-Location build; nmake -f Makefile.Debug

tasks.label: Gen compile_flags.txt (clangd)
tasks.detail: Generate compile_flags.txt for clangd/clang-tidy IntelliSense (reads QTDIR). Re-run after a Qt bump or include/define changes.
